You are an expert cardiac electrophysiology and quantitative pharmacology assistant.

Your task is to write ONLY the LaTeX text for the Results section of a manuscript, describing simulation results for the in silico simulation using parameters from certain anti-arrythmic drug. The drug name and its parameter are located in the parameter file. You absolutely need to check that to learn about the name of the drug and its cmax values.

In THIS response, you must ONLY describe the Results subsections corresponding to Figures 17–20. Do NOT mention any figures prior to Figure 17 and beyond Figure 20. Every Figures need to be explained in one paragraph.

Structure:
- Write 4 comprehensive paragraphs, one for each of Figures 17–20, in order.
- Describe what the feature is, explain the boxplot elements and units, describe at least one trend across concentrations, give at least one concrete numeric example from the feature summary CSV (median or bounds), and interpret what the pattern means for TdP risk or electrophysiological behavior.
- Use proper transition to make each paragraph coherent to each other. However, do not use Finally as the transition since there will be continuation of the paragraph. Assume there will be a continuation at the final paragraph

Fixed meanings:
- Figure 17: distribution of APD triangulation values across concentrations (boxplot), with the LaTex label {fig:features-apdtri}.
- Figure 18: distribution of maximum action potential values across concentrations (boxplot), with the LaTex label {fig:features-vmmax}.
- Figure 19: distribution of minimum action potential values across concentrations (boxplot), with the LaTex label {fig:features-vmrest}.
- Figure 20: distribution of maximum rates of action potential upstroke (max dV/dt) across concentrations (boxplot), with the LaTex label {fig:features-dvmdtmax}.

STRICT LATEX RULES:
- Read the sample_latex_full.tex LaTeX file and follow their way of writing. Do not add any new special characters or some units not defined from that template.
- Output MUST be valid LaTeX body content only (no \documentclass, no preamble, no \begin{document}).
- Do not make any new section or subsection.
- Do NOT use Markdown at all: no backticks, no ``` fences, no # headings, no `*` or `**` for emphasis.
- Do NOT use any LaTeX SI-unit helper commands (such as those from the siunitx package). Write all units explicitly as plain text (e.g., ms, nA/uF, nM) next to the numbers, either in text or math mode.
- Use standard LaTeX sectioning commands such as \section, \subsection, \paragraph as needed.
- You may use math mode with $...$ or \( ... \), but do NOT wrap the entire answer in a single math environment.
- Use ASCII characters only; avoid Unicode symbols.
- Make sure all braces { } and math modes are balanced.
- Make sure the Referencing Figure have the correct tag. The example is ~\ref{fig:time-series-ina}. Do not make another format for Referencing Figure.
- For time, unit used is millisecond. Write it as ms.

Please generate the LaTeX text for the Results subsections corresponding to Figures 17–20 only, using the attached CSV time-series data, features summary, and LaTeX template as guidance. Follow the style and level of detail implied by the template from sample_latex_full.tex.
